introduction: Gerbera daisies are stunning, vibrant flowers celebrated for their remarkable durability. With their large, colorful blooms, they are not only eye-catching but also symbolize happiness, innocence, purity, and joy. These delightful flowers are a timeless choice for any celebration, ensuring that your floral designs or arrangements leave a lasting impression! Where to use Gerberas Home Décor. Gerberas are virtually fragrance-free and non-toxic, making them ideal for any room in your home or at the office where strong scents may trigger allergies. They can be paired with other flowers or displayed alone for a modern look. Gifting and Celebrations. Embodying happiness and joy, Gerberas are perfect for birthdays, holidays, graduations, appreciation, and get-well wishes. Weddings & Special Events. Gerberas are popular among both DIY and professional designers for use in centerpieces, bridal bouquets, and as cheerful accents on wedding cakes. How they arrive Packaging: Sleeved stems are laid flat in specialized, ventilated floral boxes. The stems are typically anchored to the bottom of the box using zip ties and reinforced cardboard straps to prevent the heavy heads from shifting during shipping. Stem Straws & Sleeves: Individual stems are inserted into small plastic tubes or straws to keep them straight. The stems are then slipped into individual plastic sleeves. These sleeves protect the petals and hold the flowers securely in place during transit. Protective Nets: For safety during transit, protective mesh nets are placed over the blooms. Remove these nets as soon as the flowers are unboxed and placed into water. Flower Care Once your Gerbera Daisies arrive, they are typically thirsty and may appear droopy. Unwrap: Immediately open the box, cut the zip ties, and remove all protective plastic sleeves & nets. Cut Stems: Cut about 1 inch off the bottom of each stem at a 45-degree angle. Hydrate: Place them in a clean vase with roughly 3 to 4 inches of fresh water mixed with a floral preservative. Display: Keep your beautiful Gerbera Daisies in a cool area, away from direct sunlight and heat sources. Change the water and recut the stems every 2 to 3 days. When cared for properly, these beautiful flowers can brighten any space for 7 to 14 days in a vase!

Pro Tips & Tricks: How to Make Your Flowers Last Longer Before your flowers ship, they are prepared for their journey with proper hydration methods. If your flowers appear sleepy and thirsty after their journey, this is absolutely normal! Just follow these simple steps for proper rehydration and watch them bloom to their fullest potential. Unpack your flowers immediately upon arrival. Fill a clean container/vase with fresh, cool water. Using sharp scissors or garden shears, make a 45-degree angle cut at least 1-2 inches off the end of the stems. Place the flowers in the prepared container or vase. Arrange as desired. Allow your flowers to properly hydrate for 1-2 hours. Remove any foliage that falls below the waterline of your container. Leaves will rot and cause bacteria to form and shorten the flower's life. Re-cut the stems and refresh the flower food and water every two days. Do not place flowers in direct sunlight or near fruits, heat and drafts. Remove wilting flowers at any time to prevent bacterial growth. Check out our Floral Care Guide for seasonal stems and other floral beauties. Need to Know! The vase not only enhances the beauty of the flowers but also ensures their longevity. Simply add water and watch as the flowers bloom, bringing joy and smiles to all who see them. Pro Tips & Tricks: How to Make Your Flowers Last Longer Before your flowers ship, they are prepared for their journey with proper hydration methods. If your flowers appear sleepy and thirsty after their journey, this is absolutely normal! Just follow these simple steps for proper rehydration and watch them bloom to their fullest potential. 1. Unpack your flowers immediately upon arrival. 2. Fill a clean container/vase with fresh, cool water. 3. Using sharp scissors or garden shears, make a 45-degree angle cut at least 1-2 inches off the end of the stems. 4. Place the flowers in the prepared container or vase. Arrange as desired. 5. Allow your flowers to properly hydrate for 1-2 hours. 6. Remove any foliage that falls below the waterline of your container. Leaves will rot and cause bacteria to form and shorten the flower's life. 7. Re-cut the stems and refresh the flower food and water every two days. 8. Do not place flowers in direct sunlight or near fruits, heat and drafts. 9. Remove wilting flowers at any time to prevent bacterial growth. Check out our Floral Care Guide for seasonal stems and other floral beauties.

introduction: These Seville Classics UltraHD 4-Door Stackable Locker Cabinets provide secure and convenient storage. They are constructed of heavy-duty steel with UltraGuard fingerprint resistant stainless-steel doors. They feature a built-in locking system (keys included) with an optional padlock latch. Each locker door has a ventilated airflow design to minimize the trapping of odors, individual identity slots for labelling, and closes by magnetic latch. Each locker includes a set of four thick, adjustable rubber-padded leveling feet (8 pieces total), ensuring overall stability. The stackable 2-door lockers each measure 15" W x 18" D x 37.5" H (73.9" H when stacked together). Each locker compartment has internal dimensions of 14.75" W x 16" D x 16" H. These lockers are ideal for use in garages, schools, daycare centers and other businesses. Have the peace of mind that all your belongings are secured and protected. What are these lockers made from? The lockers are crafted with 100% commercial-grade steel with a durable powder coated body. The doors are made of 100% stainless-steel with an UltraGuard fingerprint-resistant coating to protect against smudges. Can each locker compartment be individually locked? Yes! Each locker door includes a built-in locking system (keys included) with an optional padlock latch. What is the weight capacity of the 2-door stackable lockers? Each locker has a weight capacity of 250 lbs. When stacked, the total weight capacity is 500 lbs. Do these locker cabinets need to be stacked? This 2 pack of Seville Classics UltraHD 2-Door Stackable Locker Cabinets can be used individually, side by side or stacked on top of each other. Are these lockers stable? Yes! Each locker includes a set of four thick, adjustable rubber-padded leveling feet (8 pieces total), allowing for extra stability. Maximize Your Space with UltraHD These UltraHD locker cabinets are designed for heavy-duty use in commercial, home, office, school and warehouse environments. These lockers create a unique and secure modular storage design to transform your space and maximize your storage! Assembly (Click or tap to view and download PDF)

name: 30" Wreath Storage Bag
description: Mix, match, and expand— Seville’s modular cabinets and products grow with your needs, delivering lasting value for every project. Clear front window to easily identify wreath Foam lined walls for maximum protection Self standing inner frame supports the wreath, even when bag is on the ground Reinforced outer loop for hanging Wrap around zipper for easy access
introduction: Preserve Your Wreath Keep your wreath in perfect shape with the innovative Wreath Storage Bag featuring our Direct Suspend™ system. This unique system attaches directly to the wreath's frame, preventing any sagging that could potentially ruin your decoration. This bag is an ideal solution for maintaining the shape and quality of your wreath during off-season storage. Easy Identification and Sturdy Design The Wreath Storage Bag is designed with a clear window, allowing you to easily identify the stored wreath without having to open the bag. It features a hard bottom and internal frame for additional support and durability. The reinforced outer loop enables the bag to stand alone or hang on the wall, offering versatile storage options to suit your needs. Perfect Fit for Your Christmas Wreath This foam-lined Christmas wreath storage container is designed to accommodate artificial wreaths up to 30 inches in diameter and 9 inches deep. Its generous size ensures your wreath fits comfortably without being squashed or distorted. Convenient Access and Protection The 30" Wreath Storage Bag is equipped with a wrap-around zipper for easy placement and removal of your wreath. This design minimizes the risk of catching or damaging the wreath's decorations during storage. Rest assured, this durable bag will keep your beautiful wreath alive and vibrant for years to come.

introduction: Superior Ornament Storage Solution Offering a superior solution for your ornament storage needs, the 56 Christmas Ornament Storage Box with Trays is designed to keep your ornaments safe and organized throughout the year. It comes with two full trays that can each accommodate 24 4-inch ornaments. Additionally, it includes two half trays with adjustable dividers, creating 4 sections each, providing flexibility for storing different sized ornaments. Acid-Free Trays and Dividers The Christmas ornament organizer features acid-free trays and dividers. This feature protects the vibrant colors of your ornaments from damage and discoloration, ensuring that your precious ornaments retain their luster and beauty year after year. When it's time to decorate your tree, the trays can be easily removed and individually carried. This allows you to conveniently place the Christmas ornaments onto the tree directly from the tray, making the decorating process easier and more enjoyable. Thoughtful Design Features This ornament storage box is not just functional, but also features a thoughtful design. The front of the box has a clear ID window for tags, allowing you to easily keep track of your Christmas tree ornaments. It boasts a festive red exterior fabric, padded carrying handles for comfortable transportation, and is self-standing with an integrated metal frame for added durability. Long-lasting Protection With the 56 Christmas Ornament Storage Box with Trays, you can rest assured that your ornaments will remain safe and shining year after year. It's the ultimate storage solution that combines practicality, durability, and style.
